article.headline: Phillips sparks Jacksonville’s 105-61 season-opening rout of Trinity Baptist
article.description: — Jamie Phillips Jr. had 18 points in Jacksonville’s 105-61 win against Trinity Baptist on Monday as the Dolphins began the season with a victory.
article.linkText: Phillips sparks Jacksonville’s 105-61 season-opening rout of Trinity Baptist

keywords: Trinity College of Jacksonville Eagles @ Jacksonville Dolphins
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Jamie Phillips Jr. had 18 points in Jacksonville’s 105-61 win against Trinity Baptist on Monday as the Dolphins began the season with a victory. Phillips went 7 for 11 from the field, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range. Nehemiah Turner scored 16 points and added three blocks. James Morrow shot 5 for 7 from the field, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc, to finish with 12 points and five blocks. George Woods led the way for the Eagles with 15 points and five assists. Tayden Owens added 14 points and six steals for Trinity Baptist. Sherrard Adams finished with 12 points. Up next Jacksonville hosts Paine on Monday, and Trinity Baptist visits Jacksonville on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
